title: A Oath for the Sigil
author: Quentin Amberdale
blurb: Sebastian Reyes, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
